source: 624 More Than One?
target: 624 Plusquam unum?

source: Lumian remained unfazed as the brown bear uttered words in precise Highlander.
target: Lumian non perturbatus remansit, dum ursus fuscus verba in lingua Highlander accurata edidit.

source: Instead of fear, delight filled him–a clear sign that he had stumbled upon the correct location!
target: Pro metu, gaudium eum replebat—clarum signum quod locum rectum invenerat!

source: This was the Planter pathway, the main pathway of the Church of Earth Mother, known as a Druid at Sequence 5.
target: Hoc erat via Plantatorum, via principalis Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, nota in Sequentia V ut Druidus.

source: Capable of transforming into a formidable three‐meter‐tall bear.
target: Potens erat se convertere in ursum formidolosum tribus metris altum.

source: Encountering a human-speaking brown bear in the desolate forest of Hanth Island hinted at his proximity to the heavily guarded area, possibly the mysterious valley of sulfur flames from Demon legends.
target: Incidens ursum fuscum loquentem humano sermone in silva desolata Insulae Hanth insinuavit propinquitatem eius ad aream graviter custoditam, fortasse ad vallem flammarum sulphuris ex fabulis daemonum.

source: Without the signature golden straw hat, Lumian studied the brown bear’s furry visage openly, making no effort to conceal his extraordinary nature.
target: Sine insigne pileo stramineo aureo, Lumian vultum pilosum ursi fuscī aperte aspexit, nihil faciens ut naturam suam extraordinaram celaret.

source: “Alright,” he sighed with regret, turning on his heels and retracing his steps.
target: “Bene,” suspiravit cum paenitentia, convertens pedes et vestigia sua retrahens.

source: Twenty to thirty meters away, Lumian vanished from the brown bear’s view, concealed by towering trees that had stood for over a century.
target: A viginti ad triginta metra distantia, Lumian ex conspectu ursi fuscī evanuit, celatus arboribus imponentibus quae plus quam centum annos steterunt.

source: He halted, leaning against a tree trunk, and casually retrieved an item from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Constitit, in trunco arboris innixus, et rem ex sacculo viatoris sui leviter extraxit.

source: It was a pair of brown gold‐rimmed glasses–the Mystery Prying Glasses!
target: Erat par speculorum fuscis cum margine aureo—Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula!

source: Lumian had no intention of recklessly breaching the Church of Earth Mother’s protective circle and venturing into the sealed‐off region.
target: Lumian non intendebat temere perrumpere circulum tutelarem Ecclesiae Matris Terrae et in regionem clausam ingredi.

source: Perhaps it was no safer than confronting the hidden Demon on Hanth Island.
target: Fortasse non plus tuta erat quam daemonum occultum in Insula Hanth oppugnare.

source: Without sufficient and effective information, Lumian wasn’t inclined to take such risks.
target: Sine informatione sufficienti et efficaci, Lumian talia pericula capere non paratus erat.

source: What if it resembled Fourth Epoch Trier?
target: Quid, si Trier Quartae Aetatis simile esset?

source: Lumian’s strategy involved skirting the edges of the problem zone, wielding the Mystery Prying Glasses to shift his perspective and uncover hidden truths.
target: Consilium Lumiani constabat in ambulatione ad fines regionis problematicae, utens Mysteriosis Perscrutantibus Speculis ad prospectum suum mutandum et arcana occulta detegenda.

source: From Lumian’s familiarity with the Mystery Prying Glasses from previous, the item’s lower level hindered his ability to directly perceive various seals.
target: Ex cognitione praevia Lumiani de Mysteriosis Perscrutantibus Speculis, status inferior rei impedit directam eius facultatem variis sigillis percipiendi.

source: In Trier, he had utilized them multiple times but couldn’t catch a direct glimpse of Fourth Epoch Trier.
target: In Trier, ea pluries utebatur, sed directam imaginem Trier Quartae Aetatis capere non potuit.

source: Instead, he witnessed concealed elements beneath the ground, lurking in darkness, or disguised through distorted, overlooking, or prying angles.
target: Pro eo, elementa sub terra abscondita, latitantia in tenebris, vel per angulos distortos, negligentes, aut perscrutandos, observavit.

source: This inherent flaw safeguarded Lumian from directly encountering the Church of Earth Mother’s sealed artifact, thus averting potential catastrophe.
target: Hoc vitium innatum Lumian servavit ne directe occurreret artefacto clauso Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, ita cladem potentialem avertens.

source: Nonetheless, it allowed him to discern abnormal traces.
target: Tamen, id eum sinit vestigia insolita percipere.

source: And that was sufficient!
target: Et id satis erat!

source: More traces equaled more information, bringing Lumian closer to the elusive truth!
target: Plura vestigia, plura indicia, Lumian ad veritatem elusivam propius attulerunt!

source: Ready to teleport at a moment’s notice, Lumian positioned the brown gold‐rimmed glasses on the bridge of his nose.
target: Paratus ad teleportationem quolibet momento, Lumian specula fuscosa cum margine aureo in ponte nasi sui posuit.

source: An unsettling dizziness gripped him, akin to being buried underground.
target: Vertigo inopina eum oppressit, instar sub terra sepulti.

source: Despite looking up at the soil, trees, and sky, he sensed an elevated vantage point, overseeing everything.
target: Quamquam terram, arbores, et caelum contemplabat, sensum habuit prospectus excelsi, omnia intuens.

source: Withering tree bark, decaying leaves, crawling insects, and animals circling a water source–all these details and buried bones spun in Lumian’s vision, inducing nausea from the depths of his soul.
target: Exaridens cortices arborum, folia putrida, insecta serpitantia, atque animalia circa fontem aquae – haec omnia atque ossa sepulta in visu Lumiani revoluta erant, nauseam ex intimo animæ fundo inferentes.

source: Amidst the nausea creeping from the depths of his soul, Lumian’s gaze fixated on a startling sight.
target: Inter nauseam, quae ex intimo animæ fundo procedebat, oculi Lumiani in aspectu stupefacto fixi sunt.

source: Silent blue flames devoured the entire landscape.
target: Flammae caeruleae tacitae totam regionem devorabant.

source: Whether above, below, or around the flames, the trees swiftly transformed into an inky black, dissolving into sewage.
target: Sive supra, sive infra, sive circa flammas, arbores celeriter in atrum nitidum mutaverunt se, dissolventes in lutum faeculentum.

source: From the decaying remnants, new trees sprouted, rapidly expanding and flourishing.
target: Ex reliquiis corruptis, nova arbores ortae sunt, celeriter crescentes et florentes.

source: In the midst of the blue inferno, Lumian vaguely discerned a crimson, colossal figure sprawled at the core.
target: In medio caerulei incendio, Lumian vix discerpsi ingentem figuram rubram, quae in ipso centro iacuit.

source: Submerged in pitch-black, viscous sewage, it sank gradually, only to be yanked upward by an invisible force.
target: Submersus in lutum atrum viscosum, lente descendit, ut a vi invisibili sursum traheretur.

source: This unseen power emanated from beyond the withering and burgeoning forest, from…
target: Haec vis invisibilis emanabat ex ultra silvam, quae deficiens atque augens erat, ex…

source: Abruptly, a pair of eyes materialized within Lumian’s line of sight.
target: Subito, par oculorum in conspectu Lumiani apparuit.

source: They were bloodshot, icy-blue eyes tinged with pain.
target: Erant oculi, rubiginosi, caerulei glacialibus, et dolore tincti.

source: Without hesitation, Lumian removed the Mystery Prying Glasses and activated the black mark representing Spirit World Traversal.
target: Sine mora, Lumian Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula removit et signum nigrum activavit, repraesentans transitum in Mundi Spirituum.

source: Swiftly fading, he disappeared into the forest and reappeared outside the Church of Earth Mother Cathedral in Port Hanth, behind the familiar stone pillar observed earlier that morning.
target: Celeriter evanescens, se in silvam abscondit et deinde extra Cathedral Ecclesiae Matris Terrae in Portu Hanth apparuit, post lapidem notum mane visum.

source: After stashing the Mystery Prying Glasses back into his Traveler’s Bag, Lumian departed the secluded spot. Blending in with believers, he entered the cathedral exuding scents of wheat and milk, occupying a pew closest to the Sacred Emblem of Life. With crossed arms, he mimicked the old man in a black formal suit, feigning prayer.
target: Postquam Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula in sacculo viatoris redeposuit, Lumian locum solitarium deseruit. Coniungens se cum fidelibus, intravit in cathedral Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, exhalans odores tritici et lactis, sedem in subsellio proximo Sancto Emblema Vitae occupans. Brachiis transpositis, senem in veste formali nigra imitatus est, orationem simulans.

source: Only then did he exhale a sigh of relief, assured that those icy-blue eyes wouldn’t target or lock onto him.
target: Tunc solum exhalavit suspirum levationis, certus illos oculos caeruleos glaciales in se non appropinquare.

source: These Mystery Prying Glasses could pass through countless hands if not in my possession. Its negative effects are indeed unique and beneficial, but they’re also very dangerous… Lumian couldn’t help but sigh inwardly.
target: Haec Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula per innumerabiles manus transire possent, nisi in mea possessione essent. Effectus eius negativos vere unici et utiles sunt, sed etiam valde periculosi… Lumian intus suspiravit.

source: Then, he analyzed the scenes witnessed through the Mystery Prying Glasses.
target: Deinde, scaenas per Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula visa examinavit.

source: There’s a region engulfed in sulfur flames, but the Church of Earth Mother’s trees seal it off, cycling between death and rebirth. It’s nearly impossible to spot from the outside. Even with the Mystery Prying Glasses, I can only vaguely discern its outline.
target: Est regio, flammarum sulphuris absorpta, sed arbores Ecclesiae Matris Terrae eam claudent, alternantes inter mortem et renascentiam. Ex exteris vix deprehendi potest. Etiam cum Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula, solummodo eius vagam formam perspicio.

source: It’s akin to lurking outside a cage and surveying the interior through the gaps in the railing.
target: Simile est latitare extra caveam et intimum per intervalla trabium inspicere.

source: Despite the Mystery Prying Glasses’ capabilities, they shouldn’t breach the seal.
target: Non obstante facultatibus, Mysteriosa Perscrutantia Specula sigillum non perrumpere debent.

source: That colossal, blood-colored figure resembles a small mountain, yet I can’t discern any details…
target: Illa ingens figura sanguine tincta parvi montis similitudine praedita est, sed singula vix discerere possum…

source: Could it be the true form of the Demon of Hanth Island?
target: Num illa vera forma daemonis Insulae Hanth sit?

source: How can others see it when it’s sealed inside, causing those who witness it to mysteriously vanish?
target: Quomodo alii id videre possunt, cum intrā claudatur, faciens ut qui id intuentur mysteriose evanescant?

source: Could there be more than one Demon on Hanth Island? The ice-blue eyes staring at me may belong to another Demon.
target: Num plures daemonēs in Insula Hanth sint? Illi oculi glacie caerulei, qui ad me spectant, fortasse alteri daemonis pertinent.

source: Is it utilizing the invisible connection between itself and the blood-colored Demon to prevent its descent into the pitch‑black, viscous sewage?
target: Num id utitur nexu invisibili inter se et daemonem sanguine tinctum ad impediendum descensum eius in lutum atrum viscosum?

source: If so, the Church of Earth Mother should eliminate the Demon active both outside and on the island. By doing so, the blood-colored Demon would lose its assistance.
target: Si ita est, Ecclesia Matris Terrae daemonem, qui et extra et in insula activus est, tollere debet. Hoc modo daemon sanguine tinctus auxilium suum amitteret.

source: Or does the Church of Earth Mother not want the blood‑colored Demon to completely sink into the pitch‑black sewage, letting the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon exist only to restrict its range and frequency?
target: An Ecclesia Matris Terrae non vult daemonem sanguine tinctum plene in lutum atrum se submergere, sinens daemonem oculis glacie caeruleis tantum exsistere, ut eius amplitudinem atque frequentiam restringat?

source: If it’s not entirely sealed, would the invisible connection between the two parties disappear? Is it because the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon will also be affected by the pitch‑black sewage?
target: Si id non omnino claudatur, num nexus invisibilis inter utrumque evanescet? Num quoque daemon oculis glacie caeruleis a lutum atrum affectus erit?

source: Lumian deepened his understanding and speculations regarding the Demon legends on Hanth Island.
target: Lumian paulatim intellexit mentalitatem et statum fabularum daemonum in Insula Hanth, sed evidentiis sufficere non potuit.

source: He sensed that his Conspirer potion had become active, showing signs of digestion, but it was still one step away.
target: Sensit potionem Conspiratoris sui activatam esse, signa digestionis ostendens, sed adhuc uno gradu esse remota.

source: He wasn’t in a rush to succeed. Instead, he pondered the mission that Naboredisley hadn’t entrusted to him and Franca.
target: Non festinabat ad successum; potius de missione quam Naboredisley ei et Francae non commisit meditatus est.

source: Killing a Demon descendant from an island in the Berserk Sea…
target: Interficere descendantem daemonis ex insula in Mare Berserco…

source: That’s correct, a descendant! The ice‑blue‑eyed Demon is a descendant of that blood‑colored Demon. Is that why an invisible connection binds them?
target: Recte, descendantem! Daemon oculis glacie caeruleis, descendantem illius daemonis sanguine tincti est. Num idcirco nexus invisibilis eos constringit?

source: Does Naboredisley desire the blood‑colored Demon to fully submerge into the pitch‑black sewage?
target: Num Naboredisley vult daemonem sanguine tinctum plene in lutum atrum se submergere?

source: Is this beneficial or detrimental for the blood‑colored Demon?
target: Num hoc prodest aut nocet daemonī sanguine tinctī?

source: If it’s beneficial, it makes sense why the Earth Mother Church impedes it. Why does the blood‑colored Demon’s descendant persist in pulling and preventing its descent?
target: Si id prodest, rationabile est cur Ecclesia Matris Terrae id impediat. Cur descendantia daemonis sanguine tincti perseverat in trahendo eiusque descensum prohibendo?

source: Suppose the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon is under the control of the Church of Earth Mother, yet it can kill and cause disappearances. Conversely, why doesn’t it flee Hanth Island? This implies that it’s not in the ice‑blue‑eyed Demon’s favor if the blood‑colored Demon were to completely sink into the pitch‑black sewage. It’s even willing to forfeit its freedom to obstruct it.
target: Supponatur daemon oculis glacie caeruleis sub potestate Ecclesiae Matris Terrae esse, et tamen occidere atque evanescendi casus provocare posse. Contra, cur non fugitur Insula Hanth? Id indicat non favorem esse daemonis oculis glacie caeruleis, si daemon sanguine tinctus plene in lutum atrum se submergeret. Etiam paratus est libertatem suam abdicare ut eius descensum impederet.

source: If it’s not favorable, perhaps Naboredisley isn’t deceiving. It’s an adversary of the blood‑colored Demon, hoping for its complete submersion and assimilation by the pitch‑black sewage. This might have a certain impact on Hanth Island, the Berserk Sea, or even the entire world. That’s why the Church of Earth Mother seals and monitors it…
target: Si non id favet, fortasse Naboredisley non decipit. Adversarius est daemonis sanguine tincti, sperans eius plene submersionem et assimilationem per lutum atrum. Hoc certe implicationem habere potest in Insula Hanth, in Mare Berserco, aut etiam in toto orbe terrarum. Propterea Ecclesia Matris Terrae id claudit et vigilet…

source: Can’t they just kill it? Without the blood‑colored Demon, the issue of it sinking completely into the pitch‑black sewage would cease…
target: Num illud non interficere possent? Sine daemon sanguine tincto, quaestio eius plene in lutum atrum se submergere cessaret…

source: Can’t be killed?
target: Num non occidi potest?

source: What Naboredisley feared wasn’t that the blood‑colored Demon might sense danger, but that the Church of Earth Mother might be alerted?
target: Id quod Naboredisley timebat non erat, ne daemon sanguine tinctus periculum sentiret, sed ut Ecclesia Matris Terrae alertaretur?

source: Lumian gradually understood the mentality and stance of the Church of Earth Mother, the local Demon, and Naboredisley, but he lacked sufficient evidence.
target: Lumian paulatim intellexit mentalitatem et statum Ecclesiae Matris Terrae, daemonis locali, et Naboredisley, sed evidentiis sufficere non potuit.

source: What he was most certain of now was: the pitch‑black, viscous sewage wasn’t simple!
target: Quod nunc certissime sciebat erat: lutum atrum viscosum non erat simplex!

source: Perhaps it was something akin to the Samaritan Women’s Spring.
target: Fortasse erat aliquid simile Fons Mulierum Samaritarum.

source: Furthermore, it bore a striking resemblance to the pitch‑black form of the Montsouris ghost.
target: Praeterea, formam atram phantasmatis Montsouris egregie similem habebat.

source: Trier’s catacombs is a labyrinth of complexity, filled with corruption and unique monsters that defy easy elimination.
target: Catacumbae Trierensis labyrinthus sunt complexitatis, pleni corruptionis atque monstris singularibus, quae facile extingui non possunt.

source: It’s the aftermath of Blood Emperor Alista Tudor’s significant accomplishment, an act that nearly brought the gods down with Him. Ultimately, He perished.
target: Est effectus res magni Imperatoris Sanguinis Alista Tudor, actus qui fere deos cum eo deiecit. Denique, ipse perivit.

source: What could be the reason for Hanth Island? Could it be a divine battle and the demise of a deity?
target: Quid esset causa Insulae Hanth? Num pugna divina atque exitus deitatis esset?

source: That’s not beyond the realm of possibility…
target: Haec non excedunt fines possibilitatis…

source: While my knowledge of the Fourth Epoch’s history is limited, I do know that the Berserk Sea was not as tumultuous back then.
target: Quamquam scientia mea de historia Aetatis Quartae limitata est, scio Mare Berserco tunc non tam turbulentum fuisse.

source: There were still interactions between the Northern and Southern Continents.
target: Inter Continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales adhuc commercia existēbant.

source: Could it be that another emperor from the War of the Four Emperors or two emperors met Their end here, permanently reshaping the terrain and weather to give rise to the Berserk Sea?
target: Num fortasse alius imperator ex Bello Quattuor Imperatorum aut duo imperatores hic occiderunt, terram atque tempestatem in perpetuum mutantes, ut Mare Berserco oriretur?

source: Is this the manifestation of a deity’s power? The Blood Emperor sank a colossal city underground, forcing over a million people to live above it to contain the subsequent effects.
target: Num hoc sit manifestatio potentiae deitatis? Imperator Sanguinis ingentem urbem subterraneam deiecit, cogens plus quam unam milionem hominum super eam manere ad effectus consequentis continendos.

source: And the deity who perished here has been influencing the Berserk Sea for more than a thousand years. This surpasses the waters near Port Santa…
target: Et deitas, quae hic perivit, Mare Berserco per plus quam mille annos affecit. Hoc aquas prope Portum Santae superat…

source: As Lumian sighed, he prepared to stand up and return to the Berries to strategize his next move for gathering more information.
target: Dum Lumian suspiravit, se paravit surgere et ad Berries redire ut ulterius consilium caperet ad plura indicia colligenda.

source: Sensing the quietude around him, his movements softened, cautious not to disturb the prayers of the Earth Mother believers.
target: Sentiens silentium circa se, motus eius molliti sunt, cavens ne preces cultorum Matris Terrae perturbaret.

source: Subconsciously scanning his surroundings, Lumian noticed that the believer beside him had also finished praying and retracted his arms.
target: Subconscius circumspiciens, Lumian animadvertit credulum iuxta se preces finisse atque brachia retrahesse.

source: A gray-haired old man in a black formal suit with a bow tie caught Lumian’s eye.
target: Senex canitie in veste formali nigra cum papiliono oculum Lumiani attraxit.

source: His face bore well-defined features, and his beard was meticulously shaved.
target: Facies eius lineamenta bene definitā habebat, et barba eius diligenter rasum erat.

source: In the next moment, Lumian observed the elder turning his head—revealing bloodshot ice‑blue eyes.
target: In proximo momento, Lumian senem caput vertentem observavit, ostendens oculos sanguine congestos et glacie caeruleos.
